bio: Megan Schulz First-Year Social Committee Elm Yard Hi! My name is Megan Schulz and I am from Hartford, Wisconsin! I am a first-year living in Grays West, and I want to concentrate in Molecular and Cellular Biology with a secondary in Global Health and Health Policy. Outside of FYSC I am involved with Women in Medicine and Women in Science at Harvard-Radcliffe, as well as The Crimson and HUHPR. Needless to say I stay pretty busy, but that is why I am so excited to be on FYSC! I cannot wait to get more involved with my peers and plan fun events throughout the year! If you ever see me around feel free to say hi as I would love to get to know more of my classmates. Looking forward to a great year with you all!
